page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r6.6xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 24 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 8269CY processors running at a baseline clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The system is configured with 192.0 GB of system memory, establishing an 8.0 GB memory-to-vCPU ratio.

This instance type does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. It also lacks integrated GPU hardware accelerators and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Network connectivity is supported by an 8 Gbps baseline network bandwidth.

The high memory density of 8.0 GB per vCPU provides qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring large memory footprints relative to compute resources, avoiding the need to provision larger, more expensive instances just to satisfy RAM requirements. This hardware profile is designed for memory-intensive applications such as in-memory databases, caching layers, data analytics, and enterprise applications that require substantial memory capacity without requiring local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration.
